headline: When Is It Time to Call a Pro for Tile Work?
articleBody: Tile work might seem like a straightforward DIY project, but there are definitely times when bringing in a professional installer makes all the difference. You'll want to call a pro if you're dealing with showers or other wet areas where proper waterproofing is absolutely critical. Getting this wrong can lead to serious and costly water damage. If your floors aren't perfectly flat, a professional has the expertise to address those uneven surfaces, ensuring your tile lays perfectly without lippage or cracking. Large-format tiles are another tricky one; they're heavier, harder to handle, and require precise installation to look good. Natural stone tiles, like marble or travertine, also demand specialized knowledge for cutting, sealing, and installation to protect their delicate beauty. If you have intricate patterns in mind, like mosaics or complex geometric designs, a pro can execute these with the precision and artistry they deserve. And, of course, if structural conditions need to be verified before installation, or if you need careful coordination with other trades like plumbers or electricians, a seasoned contractor like Frasheski Construction has the experience to manage all those moving parts for your project in the East Bay. Don't risk your investment; sometimes the best DIY is knowing when to call an expert.
